audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Urgot five of the seven rows and Skill for Level 1 and 2+ items, contradicting the packet chart and their own whys[] text (whys[2] and whys[3] call Levels 3-5 skill/even, whys[5] calls first item skill-based, whys[6] says late game favours you, whys[0] says Urgot wins Level 1).
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Urgot / Urgot / Skill / Skill / Urgot / Skill / Wukong and the prose already matches it. The mirror audit (urgot__wukong) records the same five-row flip, so both directions now read the same.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, ratings normalised across the chart, and the generic full-layer whys rewritten so each stage says why that side owns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed Cyclone's double knockup wins every committed brawl on the Level 6 stage that belongs to Urgot, and phases[6].why was a generic 'side-lane pattern at full power' line with a carry-threat number instead of a reason.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death is a 2500-range execute on 100/85/70s — it is the Level 6 spike and it is his. The 2-item stage is Wukong's because the clone absorbs the R lock-on and Cyclone flanks past Echoing Flames rather than eating it head-on.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now names the 2500 range and the execute threshold; the 2+ item stage now states the clone/Cyclone flank as the reason Wukong owns it.
sources: enemyKit R range 2500 cd 100/85/70 execute flag

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] was headed 'Avoid his W shred' but its body described Urgot wasting Disdain, and dontsFull[1] 'Get flipped' carried a body about burning your own cooldown. Neither Purge's 490 range and self-slow nor Disdain's 16s cooldown and shield appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Purge is a 490-range channel that slows Urgot himself while it ramps, so stepping out of range beats trading through it. Disdain is a 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s charge that both hard-CCs and shields him, which is why the clone is worth holding for it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now states Purge's range and self-slow; dontsFull[1].d states Disdain's stun-plus-shield and the 16s window; breakdown.cooldowns now carries both real numbers.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Echoing Flames leg blasts and Corrosive Charge zone your last-hits from 800 range — take the CS, refuse the trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Urgot must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online and trades turn skill-based: bait Purge on the clone, then punish him while it is winding down.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even stretch: Disdain is 16s at rank 1, so the moment he flips or whiffs it you have a clean window for the full pattern.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 units and executes below the threshold, so any trade that leaves you low turns into a death.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver plus Cyclone lets you pick the angle — force it while Disdain is on its 16s.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: the clone eats his R lock-on and Cyclone flanks past the leg blasts, so you reach his carries and he cannot chase.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Disdain: 16s at rank 1 and his only engage — decoy it and he cannot start. - Purge: 490 range and self-slowing, so walk out rather than trade through it. - Cyclone: kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Purge self-slows him as it ramps — leave 490 range and it fizzles.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain stuns and shields him on a 16s clock — hold the clone for it.

notes: ownerKit was null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldowns were written — every number here is Urgot's from enemyKit. Level-chart flips are proposed as one matched full+content group with the ratings.
